record.paper_title: Negative (and Positive) Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
record.original_question: For a signed graph Σ, determine the maximum number p−(Σ) of pairwise vertex-disjoint negative circles.

evidence.quote: Qn. 1−. Given Σ, what is the value of p−(Σ)? Ans. Unknown.

artifact.category_tag: signed graphs and disjoint negative circles
artifact.self_contained_problem: A signed graph is a pair $\Sigma = (G, \sigma)$ where $G = (V, E)$ is a finite undirected graph (loops and multiple edges allowed) and $\sigma : E \to \{+1, -1\}$ is a sign function on the edges. A circle (cycle) $C$ in $G$ is called negative if the product $\prod_{e \in E(C)} \sigma(e) = -1$, and positive otherwise. Two circles are said to be vertex-disjoint if they share no vertex of $G$. Define\n$$p^-(\Sigma) := \max\{k : \Sigma \text{ contains } k \text{ pairwise vertex-disjoint negative circles}\}.$$\nProblem: Given an arbitrary signed graph $\Sigma$, determine $p^-(\Sigma)$. That is, find a structural formula, a min–max characterization, or a tractable method to compute (or tightly bound) the maximum number of pairwise vertex-disjoint negative circles in $\Sigma$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of determining $p^-(\Sigma)$ for general signed graphs is reported as unknown/open in the standard problem collection on negative circles in signed graphs. Subsequent work has addressed special cases (e.g., algorithms for deciding existence of two vertex-disjoint negative circles by Hochstättler et al., and packing results for restricted classes such as antibalanced planar signed graphs of large negative girth), but no general formula or efficient solution is known.

status_evidence.title: Negative Circles in Signed Graphs: A Problem Collection
status_evidence.snippet: Qn. 1−. Given Σ, what is the value of p−(Σ)? Ans. Unknown.
status_evidence.claim: The general problem of computing p^-(Σ) is listed as unknown.

status_evidence.title: On the packing number of antibalanced signed simple planar graphs of negative girth at least 5
status_evidence.snippet: Packing number results for restricted classes of signed planar graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Only special cases of the negative-circle packing problem have been resolved.

status_evidence.title: Packing Signatures in Signed Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Studies packing problems related to signatures in signed graphs.
status_evidence.claim: Related packing questions have been studied but the general p^- problem remains unsolved.
